title: Tile settings of an area entity (read)
description: Per-placement presentation and behavior of an entity card as delivered by the hub (WS get_area, Admin REST). The writable fields are defs.json#/$defs/tile_settings_base; icon_svg and secondary_state are hub output and never accepted on write. {} = everything default. An app may ignore the settings and show the standard card (guests always do); apps that do not know the field ignore it (tolerant decoding). Fallback rules: docs/protocol.md, Tile settings.

icon_svg.description: Hub output: SVG path of the effective MDI icon (tile.icon when mdi:, else an mdi: icon set in Home Assistant, attributes.icon). null or absent for sf: icons and when no MDI icon applies.

secondary_state.description: Hub output for secondary.source=entity: state of secondary.entity_id at request time (sanitized like area-entity.state); null when unavailable.
